source_name: CBCG — Saopštenja (press releases)
why_relevant: Primary channel where CBCG announces Council sessions, governor/vice-governor appointments, senior staff and organisational changes. Confirmed items include 'Skupština izabrala nove viceguvernere CBCG' and repeated 'Održana N. sjednica Savjeta CBCG' posts summarising Council decisions.

source_name: CBCG — Oglas za prijem u radni odnos / Tenderi i oglasi
why_relevant: CBCG's own vacancy notices. Job titles reveal how the supervisor is reorganising (e.g. quantitative risk modelling / stress testing controllers, macroeconomic analysis, payments/fintech units). Direct evidence for hiring and organisation-change topics.

source_name: CBCG — Zapošljavanje (careers policy / channels page)
why_relevant: States explicitly where CBCG publishes vacancies — zzzcg.me, print media, cbcg.me, prekoveze.me, and its social accounts (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X). A single page that enumerates the whole recruitment-signal surface for this cell.

source_name: CBCG — Upravljanje (Council composition)
why_relevant: Authoritative current roster of the CBCG Council (governor, three vice-governors, four external members — confirmed names Tamara Backović, Srđan Milić, Šućo Orahovac, Ismet Hadžić) plus the legal appointment mechanism and mandate lengths. Diffing this page detects leadership change.

source_name: CBCG — Rukovođenje (executive management)
why_relevant: Sibling section listing executive management below Council level; changes here indicate directorate-level reshuffles that rarely get a press release.

source_name: CBCG — Unutrašnja organizacija / Stalna tijela Savjeta / Radna tijela
why_relevant: Internal organisation chart, standing Council bodies (Audit Committee, Advisory Board) and working bodies. The canonical evidence of supervisory restructuring — new/renamed directorates for payments, fintech, AML.

source_name: CBCG — Strateški plan 2025–2028
why_relevant: Forward-looking statement of what capabilities CBCG intends to build (typically payments modernisation, supervision capacity, EU alignment) — predicts the hiring and unit creation that will later appear as vacancies.

source_name: CBCG — Registar banaka / kreditnih institucija
why_relevant: Statutory register of licensed credit institutions. Under the Law on Credit Institutions the register carries management-body data; CBCG also keeps an evidence of issued approvals for board members and executive directors. This is the mechanism by which a leadership change at any licensed Montenegrin bank becomes public as a regulatory record.

source_name: CBCG — Kontrolna funkcija (supervision function hub)
why_relevant: Hub describing licensing and approvals ('izdavanje dozvola i odobrenja') for credit institutions and financial-service providers; links onward to registers, supervised-entity lists and credit-register services. Best entry point for enumerating fit-and-proper artefacts.

source_name: CBCG — Podzakonski akti: Kontrola banaka (secondary legislation)
why_relevant: Holds the fit-and-proper rulebook — e.g. 'Odluka o bližim uslovima koje mora ispunjavati član odbora direktora banke' (Sl. list CG 80/2010) and the decision on conditions for selection/appointment of management-body members and key function holders in credit institutions, plus the decision governing the register's content. Defines what is legally required to be published, so it tells the collector what to expect.

source_name: Službeni list Crne Gore (Official Gazette) — propisi search
why_relevant: Legal record of publication for CBCG acts and parliamentary appointment decisions (odluke o imenovanju/razrješenju). Searchable by issuing body, with CBCG listed as a donosilac. Confirmed example: the CBCG Statute is published here; the fit-and-proper decision appears in Sl. list CG 80/2010.

source_name: Skupština Crne Gore — Odbor za ekonomiju, finansije i budžet
why_relevant: The Assembly appoints the CBCG governor, vice-governors and non-employed Council members; the finance committee runs the consultative hearings and proposes candidates. Committee materials expose candidate shortlists weeks before the appointment — confirmed case: Backović, Milić, Orahovac, Hadžić heard before the committee and subsequently seated on the Council.

source_name: Bankar.me — CBCG hiring and appointment coverage
why_relevant: Specialist Montenegrin banking portal that republishes CBCG vacancy notices in near-real time with full position titles and organisational units, and covers regulator/bank leadership news. Useful redundancy against the CBCG site and easier to parse.

source_name: Zavod za zapošljavanje Crne Gore (ZZZCG) — job board
why_relevant: The national employment agency; CBCG's own careers page names it as a statutory publication channel for its vacancies. Structured, searchable, and covers licensed banks too — a systematic feed for the jobs/hiring topic in this cell.

source_name: Prekoveze.me — Montenegrin job portal named by CBCG
why_relevant: Explicitly listed by CBCG as one of the portals where it advertises vacancies; also carries bank and fintech postings, giving broader A5 jobs coverage for the Montenegrin financial sector.

source_name: Posao.crna.gora.me — employer pages for supervisors
why_relevant: Aggregator with per-employer pages for Montenegrin financial-supervision bodies (confirmed page for Agencija za nadzor osiguranja), giving a low-friction hiring feed for supervisors whose own sites publish irregularly.

source_name: Komisija za tržište kapitala Crne Gore (Capital Market Authority, SCMN)
why_relevant: Adjacent financial supervisor. Issues approvals for the selection/appointment of executive directors and board members of market organisers, investment firms and the central clearing and depository company — the same fit-and-proper signal as CBCG but for the capital-market side of payments/securities infrastructure.

source_name: Agencija za nadzor osiguranja (ANO) — insurance supervisor
why_relevant: Insurance supervisor with a statutory fit-and-proper approval regime for board members and executive directors (approval may also be withdrawn). Relevant to bancassurance and to cross-sector leadership moves; also a supervisor whose own restructuring signals sector-wide reorganisation.

source_name: Fond za zaštitu depozita Crne Gore (FZDCG)
why_relevant: Deposit guarantee scheme, part of the financial-safety-net governance. Its Upravni odbor and director are appointed via public competition (konkurs) — confirmed reporting of an expired director mandate and a second konkurs with 11 qualifying candidates. A clean, low-noise leadership-change signal.

source_name: CBCG official LinkedIn page
why_relevant: Named by CBCG itself as a vacancy-publication channel; also the fastest surface for staff self-reported role changes and new-unit announcements. Same applies to the Capital Market Authority's page.

source_name: Montenegrin general media covering CBCG appointments (Dan, RTNK, Mondo, Antena M, CdM, Aktuelno, Vijesti)
why_relevant: Reports appointment votes, committee shortlists and political friction around CBCG independence, often earlier and with more names than the official statement. Confirmed coverage of the vice-governor elections and of the Council candidate slate.

source_name: Žurnal.me — investigative coverage of CBCG appointment rules
why_relevant: Investigative outlet tracking proposed changes to how the CBCG governor is selected (e.g. a move to open competition). Reveals-indirectly source for upcoming changes to the appointment mechanism itself, which reshapes the whole signal pipeline for this cell.

source_name: CBCG English-language site mirror (/e/ path)
why_relevant: English mirror of press releases and regulation pages, useful for machine processing and for cross-checking translated titles of appointments and Council sessions. Coverage lags and is partial versus /me/, so it is a complement, not a substitute.

source_name: CBCG site search endpoint
why_relevant: Parameterised on-site search (q, filter, page) — a practical harvesting entry point for terms like 'imenovan', 'viceguverner', 'saglasnost', 'oglas' across the whole domain without guessing section paths.

source_name: Portal eUprava Crne Gore — supervisory approval e-services
why_relevant: Government e-services catalogue documenting the fit-and-proper application procedures (what a candidate for a board member / executive director must file, which body decides, in what timeframe). Explains the administrative pipeline behind every approval, so it dates and sequences the signals collected elsewhere. A CBCG service entry also exists.

source_name: Propisi.net Montenegro — consolidated legislation (Zakon o CBCG, Zakon o kreditnim institucijama, Zakon o osiguranju)
why_relevant: Consolidated, cross-referenced texts of the laws that create the publication duties this cell depends on. Useful to establish exactly which approvals must be published and where, and to detect amendments (e.g. the draft amendments to the Law on Credit Institutions adopted by the CBCG Council).

source_name: CKB (Crnogorska komercijalna banka, OTP Group) — Menadžment banke / Organi upravljanja
why_relevant: Largest Montenegrin bank by loans/deposits and clients; its 'Organi upravljanja' tree publishes Odbor direktora and Izvršni direktori with bios, so CEO/board changes and divisional restructurings are visible first here in Montenegrin. Bios name prior roles (e.g. Nikola Perišić, OTP Group since 2011), which is directly usable for leadership-move tracking.
